description: Source code for a command-line tool to manipulate Memory Technology Devices (MTD), including functions for opening, erasing, verifying, writing, and managing MTD devices, with support for different image formats and partition layouts.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the command-line tool, parsing arguments and executing commands for MTD device manipulation.

methods.name: mtd_open
methods.description: Open an MTD device, trying to resolve device number from /proc/mtd if possible.

methods.name: mtd_check_open
methods.description: Open an MTD device and retrieve its information (size, erasesize, type).

methods.name: mtd_block_is_bad
methods.description: Check if a block at a given offset is bad.

methods.name: mtd_erase_block
methods.description: Erase a block at a specified offset.

methods.name: mtd_write_buffer
methods.description: Write a buffer to an MTD device at a specified offset.

methods.name: image_check
methods.description: Check the magic number of an image file to determine its format.

methods.name: mtd_check
methods.description: Check and open an MTD device, supporting colon-separated device names.

methods.name: mtd_unlock
methods.description: Unlock one or multiple MTD devices.

methods.name: mtd_erase
methods.description: Erase all data on an MTD device, skipping bad blocks.

methods.name: mtd_dump
methods.description: Dump the contents of an MTD device to stdout.

methods.name: mtd_verify
methods.description: Verify the contents of an MTD device against a file using MD5 checksum.

methods.name: indicate_writing
methods.description: Display a message indicating data is being written to an MTD device.

methods.name: mtd_write
methods.description: Write an image to an MTD device, handling partitioning, bad blocks, and optional FIS layout updates.

methods.name: mtd_write_jffs2
methods.description: Append a file to the JFFS2 partition on an MTD device.

methods.name: trx_check
methods.description: Check the validity of a TRX image (not fully shown in code).

methods.name: trx_fixup
methods.description: Fix the checksum in a TRX header (not fully shown in code).

methods.name: mtd_fixseama
methods.description: Fix the checksum in a SEAMA header.

methods.name: mtd_fixwrg
methods.description: Fix the checksum in a WRG header.

methods.name: mtd_fixwrgg
methods.description: Fix the checksum in a WRGG03 header.

methods.name: mtd_resetbc
methods.description: Reset the U-Boot boot counter.
